newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 40 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 40 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon said on Thursday it issued certificates of deposit dated July 4 to commercial banks worth 40 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 38 billion pounds at 12.25 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds at 11.5 percent.
Last week the bank issued 60-day CDs worth 45 billion pounds and 45-day CDs worth one billion pounds at the same interest rates.
